senses.definition: n.f. raging heat (on format. cf. GesLbg 863 Ol§ 196 a. 1. 2)—ז׳ ψ 119:53; pl. abs. זִלְעָפוֹת ψ 11:6; cstr. זִלְעֲפוֹת La 5:10;—
of fever heat of famine ז׳ רָעָב La 5:10.
of burning wind רוּח ז׳ ψ 11:6 (in fig. of י׳’s judgment, with אֵשׁ, גָּפְרִית).
fig. of zeal ז׳ אֲחָזַתְנִי ψ 119:53.
